verdicts.label: FALSE
verdicts.what_is_true_en: Drinking hot water with lemon juice does not destroy the coronavirus. Health experts and fact-checkers have confirmed there is no scientific evidence that this mixture can prevent or cure COVID-19.
verdicts.reasoning_en: The claim that drinking hot water with lemon juice can destroy the coronavirus has been widely debunked by numerous fact-checking organizations and news outlets since the beginning of the COVID-19 pandemic in 2020. TIER_1 sources like AFP, FactCheck.org, BOOM Fact Check, and Snopes all rated the claim as false, stating there is no scientific proof of its effectiveness. While lemons contain Vitamin C, which can support the immune system, this does not equate to a cure or preventative measure against the coronavirus.
